    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    active_rows = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    starts = [i for i, active in enumerate(active_rows) if active and (i == 0 or not active_rows[i - 1])]
    for r in starts:
        last = max((c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != bg), default=-1)
        for c in range(last + 1, len(grid[r])):
            if grid[r][c] == bg:

    return out
